highlights.label: amber changed cells, green added row

brief: A cropped data-peek result view with the Time Machine strip open. The cursor clicks an older run, and the selection pill glides back through the newer runs while the grid's tabular digits roll to each one. The real 'Viewing run from' banner then pushes the grid down. An option-click on a newer run turns it into a diff: changed cells light amber, the added row bands green, and the banner badges count +1 added, -0 removed, and 3 cells changed. Back to live reverses everything and lands on the exact frame-0 state. The dominant motif is the selection travelling back through time while the numbers roll.
